name: sstim-reference
description: Reference for sensory stimulation terminology, definitions, provenance and versioned ontology concepts.

interface.longDescription: Explore SSTIM's published sensory-stimulation concepts, find exact IRIs and source definitions, compare frozen releases, and prepare a feedback link for human review. The server reads public semantic data and never modifies SSTIM.
defaultPrompt: Find the canonical SSTIM definition and provenance for binaural stimulation.
Compare the SSTIM description of a sensory phenomenon between frozen releases.
Prepare a user-reviewed SSTIM feedback link for a missing concept.
